title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
content: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

title: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
content: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago.  The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

title: Hands-on with the Ocarina of Time remake, the most ornate Zelda game ever made
content: We got to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time early. Here are our impressions of the remake and its elaborate new style.

title: Zelenskyy sits down with NPR. And, Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has a sit-down interview with NPR as Russia's full-scale invasion nears the 5-year mark. And, Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer.

title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
content: Factory workers in India are being asked to wear GoPro cameras to record the way they do their jobs. The ultimate goal is to train robots to take over. Will it work?

title: Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigns after allegations of improper conduct
content: The White House publicly asked for U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct.

title: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
content: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S.

title: VIDEO: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
content: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

title: In Kansas, a newly competitive Senate race tests limit of Trump's unpopular policies
content: Kansas voters could send a Democrat to the Senate for the first time in nearly a century — and flip the governor's office back to Republican control, even in what could be a tough year for the GOP.

title: Civil rights advocates plan to send thousands of observers to midterm polling places
content: For many election cycles, civil rights groups and political parties have fanned out to monitor polling places, but the charged midterm environment has many organizations stepping up efforts this year.
